discovery.mapping_cardinality: exactly one installed launcher per declared entry point
discovery.source_of_truth: each installed distribution's own declared [console_scripts] entry points, read from <dist-info>/entry_points.txt

fingerprint_exclusion: bin/** is never wholesale excluded from RuntimeFingerprintV3; only the declared console-script launcher rows move from raw semantic RECORD content into ConsoleScriptSemanticV2, retaining raw template type, hash, and size as diagnostics

normalization.cross_template_equivalence: approved raw templates are semantically identical only when their declared console-script entry point and complete non-bootstrap Python payload bytes are identical
normalization.preserved_bytes: all non-bootstrap Python payload bytes after the exact approved raw-template header

recognized_templates.description: first line is '#!' followed by the resolved interpreter path
#!/bin/sh trampoline embedding the resolved interpreter path once, in single quotes, on the second line
